items.title: Diabetes Mellitus in Pregnancy (Gestational Diabetes)
items.summary: RESOLVED (targeted follow-up, 2026-08-26): Direct full-registry search confirmed no MCC objective is dedicated to diabetes mellitus in any form (gestational or otherwise) across all 198 records, and no independent Study Smarter listing names diabetes/GDM either. However, two actual objectives explicitly and defensibly include gestational diabetes as required content: 80-1 (Prenatal care) names 'gestational diabetes' by title in its screening enabling objectives, and 130 (Hyperglycemia) names 'diabetes mellitus ... gestational' in its causal conditions. Reclassified UNCERTAIN -> COMPONENT (80-1 primary/MODERATE, 130 secondary/WEAK) per project accuracy rules.
items.recommended_action: None -- resolved. No registry gap-fill candidate needed for this unit.

items.title: Antenatal Depression / Infections During Pregnancy / Labour Analgesia-Anesthesia / Meconium / Postpartum Mood Alterations
items.summary: Flagged CROSS_DISCIPLINE: Antenatal Depression and Postpartum Mood Alterations substantially overlap Psychiatry's mood/psychotic-disorder objectives (59-1, 86); Infections During Pregnancy substantially overlaps Infectious Diseases' pathogen-specific content; Analgesic and Anesthetic Techniques in Labour and Birth substantially overlaps the Anesthesia chapter; Meconium substantially overlaps Pediatrics' neonatal resuscitation content. Per project instruction, PRIMARY_OWNER/CROSS_LINK/DISTINCT_CONTEXT designation is deferred to a later global cross-chapter audit; these are recorded here as thin CROSS_DISCIPLINE-flavored units retaining only the pregnancy-specific/obstetric-context angle rather than duplicating the sister chapters' content.
items.recommended_action: Defer to global cross-chapter ownership audit; no chapter-local action required.

items.title: Several study units carry no direct MCC objective (empty mcc_evidence or CROSS_DISCIPLINE with no own-chapter evidence)
items.summary: Infections During Pregnancy returned no matches in the packet's candidate set or via targeted search-mcc-objectives queries (e.g. 'chorioamnionitis', 'meconium', 'cesarean section', 'vacuum extraction', 'episiotomy', 'perineal laceration' all returned 0 results against research/mcc/objectives_registry.json). MCC's objective structure is presentation-based rather than disease-based (confirmed consistent with the NS/N chapter precedent), so several individually-named obstetric entities (shoulder dystocia, cord prolapse, uterine rupture, amniotic fluid embolism, chorioamnionitis, retained placenta, uterine inversion, mastitis, meconium, operative delivery specifics) have no dedicated objective and are instead anchored to the broad umbrella objectives 80-1 (Prenatal care) / 80-2 (Intrapartum and postpartum care) at WEAK-to-MODERATE strength, per project accuracy rules (DIRECT/COMPONENT requires actual MCC evidence; WEAK/UNCERTAIN when evidence is insufficient). coverage_weight for these units reflects genuine clinical/generalist priority (e.g., shoulder dystocia, cord prolapse, uterine rupture, postpartum hemorrhage all carry weight 5) independent of MCC-objective specificity.
items.recommended_action: Coordinator to confirm no MCC objective was missed via alternate query terms before finalizing these units' evidence-strength assignments.
